_doc: Map split decisions (CLAUDE.md §4.3 source of truth; design reference/guides/map_split_stage.md). Per origin map: `cuts` are source cells that become walls (a cut with walkable pieces on two opposite sides becomes an arrow-warp pair); each piece is named by seed cells whose walkable components (after the cuts) it owns. Piece uid = 10000 + origin*100 + k. Map 40's split (2026-10-09, base cuts + A, pieces 14000-14006) was retired 2026-10-17: 40 is a streamed map (reference/streamed_maps.json, streaming_prototype_plan.md stage 3). Its cut list is in git history (ec62cdbb).
